asked_by: Ace, 2026-10-31: one cash-constrained 2023 comparison, original admission vs fresh 10-15%
status: retrospective development evidence on 2023 (already studied, including by SCORE_VALUE_v1, which suggested this rule); not validation; simulation only, no orders; 2024+ not opened
models: summary and sequence separately, frozen temperature-adjusted probabilities (rank_score), no refit or recalibration
baseline: the original frozen early top-five shortlist in score order; must reproduce CRYPTO_REPLAY_v1's BASE and DOUBLE_COSTS fingerprints for both models exactly

challenger.fresh: the coin is not in the same model's original top five on the previous calendar day, regardless of yesterday's band
challenger.freshness_unknown: the previous calendar day has no frozen list (2023-01-01: no 2022-12-31 list was frozen) -> not eligible
challenger.no_refill: only alerts from the original five; vacancies stay empty
challenger.order: original rank and tie-break (score descending, ticker ascending)
challenger.note: tests the combined freshness-and-band policy, not priority alone

unchanged: everything else is idxsig.crypto_replay as audited: 10,000 USDT; notional = 0.5% of equity at the decision / loss fraction; cash reserved at the decision; risk convention = the sum of planned risk fractions (0.5% each) of pending and open positions <= 1.5%, i.e. at most three at once (the audited convention, kept and disclosed); at most 3 new orders per day; no duplicate coin; next UTC open entry; 5% stop, 10% target, bar-5 close; gaps at the open; stop-first ambiguity; missing-data and year-end rules
deliverables: per model and case: ending equity, net return, max daily-close drawdown, realized/unrealized, fees and slippage, turnover, mean exposure, alerts by eligibility reason, entries, skips and rejections
paired differences from baseline: end equity and a circular block bootstrap of daily return differences {'block_days': 10, 'draws': 2000, 'seed': 20261031}
monthly returns of both policies; share of realized P&L from the 1, 3 and 5 largest winners and P&L without the 5 largest
return per unit of mean exposure (to separate selection from simply holding less)

verdict_rules.per_case: IMPROVES if challenger ending equity > baseline and its max drawdown is not deeper; WORSE if ending equity < baseline; MIXED otherwise
verdict_rules.overall: improved the 2023 account only if IMPROVES in both models and both cost cases; any other pattern is reported as it is; either way retrospective development evidence, not a proven edge

validation: every challenger order is in that day's original five, fresh and in the band
invariants, independent trade audit, tested-accounting cross-check, identical repeat run
